title: Bitcoin miner MARA sold 13,597 BTC for $1.1 billion in six weeks, plans to sell more
content: MARA paid off every loan backed by its bitcoin and says the rest of its coins can fund AI datacenters.

title: XRP Ledger maps out quantum-proof accounts, with no extra fees for users
content: The XRP Ledger Foundation’s design lets owners add a quantum-resistant key and switch off the old one, part of a roadmap that puts the network on track for a full transition by 2028.

title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
content: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
content: The tokenization firm unveiled an acquisition and a $50 million stock buyback as quarterly revenue rose 13%. SECZ shares jumped 10% after hours.

title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
content: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

title: Crypto exchanges need hard dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says
content: “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” the cybersecurity firm told Cointelegraph.

title: OpenAI builds kill switch to stop rogue agents within 35 seconds
content: Control Room cuts off model output for internal research jobs when people or automated monitors flag safety or security concerns.

title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
content: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
content: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
content: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.0 Are Impressive, But Be Prepared to Sell a Kidney to Afford Them
content: Anthropic's latest AI can build complex software and even design physical objects. Users are producing impressive results, and estimated bills large enough to make developers wince.

title: AI Data Centers Are Buying Used Jet Engines as New Power Turbines Take Six Years
content: A shortage of new gas turbines is pushing AI developers toward refurbished power equipment and jet-engine-based generators, even as high prices, pollution concerns, and permitting delays threaten their expansion plans.

title: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
content: Google’s TPU 8tx protects sensitive AI workloads, while the dual-chip TPU 8i Max targets memory-hungry AI agents.

title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
content: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens—complete with cartoon animal and Elon Musk logos—and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools to break the trail.

title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
content: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday’s inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
content: Bitcoin Magazine Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end. This post Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking
content: Bitcoin Magazine Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking A Warren banking aide says the incoming Senate Banking chair will target prediction markets' "Wild West-style lack of oversight," after she and Sen. John Curtis pressed Kalshi and Polymarket on election trading. This post Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
content: Bitcoin Magazine North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens on NEAR between Nov. 5 and 7, moving about $430,000 of stolen Binance funds through homemade liquidity pools. This post North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress
content: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg puts only a 10% chance on a congressional ban on platform stablecoin yield over the next two years, even as banks renew their push after Democratic midterm wins. This post TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT
content: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT BlackRock's Robbie Mitchnick told Barron's demand to swap directly held bitcoin for IBIT shares is at its highest yet, with "security and peace of mind" the top reason as kidnappings and hacks rise. This post BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
